question: Can users inspect and export complete saved results from the existing module command through the same public API, without hidden filtering, scientific imports, overwritten files or ambiguous publication failures?
controls: Complete JSONL/CSV command outputs equal original saved records and scalar projection; receipt equals original configuration and actual bytes/hash
Empty, partial and explicit legacy export retains zero, failures, pending counts and original historical values
Existing inspection syntax/output, limit defaults and literal export database filename remain compatible; help requires no database
Conflicting format/ranking/limit options, unknown options and missing criterion fail before database/output I/O
Missing/corrupt databases and existing destinations preserve caller files and emit no success JSON
Actual public export prepublication and postpublication/close failures preserve empty stdout and truthful coded receipt/publication context
Fresh command processes load no scientific, citation or development-support providers
Existing reader/export controls, reporting/archive/index and full Ruff checks
One exact owned installed wheel with published support payloads runs the same controls and actual documented commands on four original complete/partial/legacy databases

resources.aggregate_limits: Use owned cgroup if available; otherwise explicitly record unavailable aggregate memory/no-swap/tasks/quota and enforce standard OS limits. Do not access another user's bus.

publication: Own executable/control text and scalar/hash receipts only; original databases, full native/query/export bodies and third-party payloads remain local
nonclaims: No new scientific computation, acquisition/preparation, collection connector, scale/speedup, biological validity, complete PHMT solve, supported platform matrix or release
